Grapefruit Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 3:27am

Ingredients




cup light-brown sugar
2 lrgs ruby-red grapefruits halved, and
at room temperature

Preparation

1 Preheat broiler. Place grapefruit halves on a rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle each half's top with 2 tablespoons brown sugar. Place under broiler for 6 minutes, turning pan, if needed, for even browning. Serve immediately. 2 This recipe yields 4 servings.
